coverage.summary: Covers rent-controlled units under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance. Units that first obtained a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979 are exempt from the rent increase limits. So are tenancies eligible for a rent increase under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act and some tenancies where the rent is regulated by another government agency. These exempt tenancies remain subject to the Ordinance's eviction provisions.
coverage.construction_date_basis: date the unit first obtained a Certificate of Occupancy
coverage.other_conditions: Applies to rent-controlled units covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance.
